meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

вести.gloss: to lead, to conduct (вести себя = to behave)

meanings.en: to lead, to guide, to drive
вести себя: to behave, to conduct oneself
meanings.note: Вы как маленькая себя ведёте = You're behaving like a little girl

examples.trans: You're behaving like a little girl.
They will give only eight years.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence

examples.trans: We could open a salon for you.

дождаться.gloss: to wait for, to live to see

meanings.en: to wait until something happens, to get by waiting (+ genitive)

examples.trans: I will wait for an answer.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it
short forms знаком, знакома, знакомо, знакомы (+ dative)

examples.text: А знакомо ли тебе, Аркашка, слово педикюр?
examples.trans: And are you familiar, Arkashka, with the word pedicure?

examples.text: Я услышал в коридоре знакомый голос.
examples.trans: I heard a familiar voice in the corridor.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know

examples.text: На улице холодно, возьми тёплую куртку.
examples.trans: It's cold outside, take a warm jacket.
I love our town very much.

meanings.note: fleeting vowel о drops in genitive/dative/prepositional (любви), kept in instrumental (любовью)

examples.text: Первый раз я запел про любовь!
examples.trans: For the first time I sang of love!

examples.text: Марина, послушайте, это всё из-за любви!
examples.trans: Marina, listen, it's all because of love!

meanings.note: уже месяц = for a month now

examples.trans: I've been living here for a month.
The election is in a month.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

meanings.en: nowhere, not anywhere (direction/destination, used with не or нет)

examples.text: Слушайте, да не нужно вам никуда ехать.
examples.trans: Listen, you don't need to go anywhere.

meanings.note: usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.

обойтись.gloss: to manage without, do without; to turn out

meanings.en: to get by without, manage without
всё обошлось = everything turned out fine

examples.trans: Try to manage without our help.
We will easily manage without a car.

meanings.note: agrees in gender and case with the noun

examples.trans: He is looking out the window.

опаздывать.gloss: to be late, to run late

meanings.en: to be late, to arrive late

examples.trans: Don't be late for the train.
Thank you for the honest answer.
I love our town very much.

meanings.note: перестань(те)! = stop it!, oh come on!

examples.text: Да перестаньте! Я двадцать лет в карты не играла.
examples.trans: Oh, stop it! I haven't played cards for twenty years.
The cat is under the table.

meanings.note: almost always in 'всё равно' = it doesn't matter; мне всё равно = I don't care

examples.trans: Why are you sitting in the corner?
The wind is blowing hard outside.

собираться.gloss: to intend, to be about to; to gather

meanings.en: to intend, to plan, to be going to

examples.text: Совершенно верно, я мэр этого города.
examples.trans: Quite right, I am the mayor of this town.
This is a completely new car.

становиться.gloss: to become, to get, to grow

examples.trans: And you are becoming an alcoholic.
There are so many mistakes there!
I don't have that much time.

meanings.note: the infinitive 'Стоять!' as a police order

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

уйти.gloss: to leave, to go away (on foot)

meanings.en: to leave, to go away, to walk out

meanings.note: на улице холодно = it's cold outside

examples.text: На Московской улице перевернули ящики с мусором.
examples.trans: On Moskovskaya Street someone tipped over the rubbish bins.

meanings.note: играть в футбол = to play football
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
